title: Sections of direct image: natural resolution comparison with cycle formula
statement: For schemes X,Y [def-pc-scheme] and f:X\to Y, put D=f_* [def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image], G=\Gamma(Y,-), and H^q(X,-)=R^q\Gamma(X,-) [pqf-def-cohomology]. There are natural isomorphisms e_q:H^q(X,-)\to R^q(D\circ G), after forgetting scalars. For every module sheaf F [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], injective resolution I of F [def-sp-injective-resolutions], and global q-cycle s of \Gamma(X,I), set K=D(I), T=G(D(I)). There is z in G(Z^q K) whose image under G(iCycles_K) is the restriction of iCycles(s) along the equality f^{-1}(Y)=X. For every c:G(Z^q K)\to Z^q T satisfying c followed by iCycles_T = G(iCycles_K), e_q sends the class of s, transported by the inverse canonical resolution identification [lem-sp-derived-well-defined], to the class of c(z), transported by the inverse canonical resolution identification for D\circ G. No edge map and no acyclicity witness is assumed.

proof.text: Construct sectionsIso by applying each underlying abelian presheaf to eqToIso of congrArg op (Opens.map_top f.base).symm. Presheaf morphism naturality proves that it is natural in the module sheaf. Apply NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex to obtain the termwise comparison.

Use ShortComplex.mapHomologyIso for exact forgetting of scalars to construct homologyForgetIso. Compose with homology of the termwise section comparison to construct sectionsHomologyIso. For any injective resolution, conjugate this natural isomorphism by isoRightDerivedObj to obtain resolutionIso. The hom and inv naturality lemmas for isoRightDerivedObj prove resolutionIso_naturality along any cochain comparison extending a coefficient map. NatIso.ofComponents on the chosen injective resolutions gives derivedSectionsIso. A cochain comparison extending the identity proves derivedSectionsIso_app for every supplied injective resolution.

The canonical homology and cycle isomorphisms for exact forgetting of scalars respect homologyπ and iCycles, by the mapped left-homology data. Cancel the monic cycle inclusion to identify the image of a cycle under the termwise comparison with any cycle having the displayed restricted degree term. homologyπ_naturality gives sectionsHomologyIso_cycle. Conjugation by the resolution isomorphisms gives derivedSectionsIso_cycle.

The sheaf evaluation functor G preserves finite limits. KernelFork.mapIsLimit applied to the direct-image complex cycle kernel identifies its sections with cycles of G applied termwise. Naturality of the upstairs differential with restriction shows the transported degree term has zero differential; construct its cycle by HomologicalComplex.cyclesMk. The preserved-kernel identification sends that cycle to z, and its inclusion identity gives the required equation. For any c satisfying c followed by iCycles = G(iCycles), evaluate this morphism equality at z. Combining with the inclusion equation for z supplies the hypothesis of derivedSectionsIso_cycle at c(z), which proves the required formula. Degree zero and empty schemes require no additional assumptions.

lean.statement:
theorem leray_sections_resolution_comparison {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    let D := RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage f.toLRSHom.toShHom
    let G := RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor Y.toRingedSpace
    ∃ e : ∀ q : ℕ,
      (RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace q ⋙ forget₂ _ AddCommGrpCat) ≅
        ((D ⋙ G).rightDerived q ⋙ forget₂ _ AddCommGrpCat),
    ∀ (q : ℕ) (F : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))
      (I : InjectiveResolution F)
      (s : (RingedSpace.globalSectionsComplex I).cycles q),
      let K := (D.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj I.cocomplex
      let T := ((D ⋙ G).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj I.cocomplex
      ∃ z : G.obj (K.cycles q),
        (I.cocomplex.X q).val.presheaf.map
            (eqToHom (congrArg op (Opens.map_top f.base).symm))
            ((RingedSpace.globalSectionsComplex I).iCycles q s) = G.map (K.iCycles q) z ∧
        ∀ (c : G.obj (K.cycles q) ⟶ T.cycles q),
          c ≫ T.iCycles q = G.map (K.iCycles q) →
          (e q).hom.app F
              ((I.isoRightDerivedObj (RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace) q).inv
                ((RingedSpace.globalSectionsComplex I).homologyπ q s)) =
            (I.isoRightDerivedObj (D ⋙ G) q).inv (T.homologyπ q (c z))
